We Build Teams That Win

 

 

 

Gameday in Death Valley

From the first down to the final whistle, nobody does gameday like LSU. Here's everything you need to be part of it.

 

Visit the LSU Fan Guide

 

 

Undergraduate Opportunities

From field goals to career goals, we empower students to follow their passion and meet challenges head-on. A top research university with some of the top-ranked programs across the nation and professors renowned around the world, LSU offers unrivaled academic opportunities and equips our students for success in their fields.

Find A Major

Discover Undergraduate Research

Graduate Opportunities

LSU is a globally minded university and offers diverse academic opportunities with over 70 master’s and 50 doctoral degree programs. Students can pursue advanced degrees through interdisciplinary, dual, joint, and combined bachelor's/master's pathways, with many programs available 100% online.

Explore Graduate Programs

Find Opportunities Beyond the Classroom

Find Yourself Here

Become a Tiger today.

Join a vibrant community of students and scholars, all driven by a shared commitment to explore ambitions, pursue dreams, and elevate opportunities. At LSU, a leading research university with top-ranked programs across the nation, we come together to ensure that learners at every stage of life have access to the education and support they need. Together, we can achieve greatness!

Apply Today

It's More Than Research

At LSU, Louisiana's flagship institution, the research we perform is not only our duty, it's what drives us. From cancer and diabetes to coastal sustainability, energy, and agriculture, we improve the lives of our neighbors and loved ones every day. As a top research university, in the past year alone, LSU achieved $601 million in research activity across its eight campuses to advance Louisiana and the world. This achievement generated $1.6 billion in economic impact for Louisiana.

Winning for Louisiana

LSU's DeepFire Team Wins XPRIZE Wildfire Award for AI That Sees Fires Coming

College of the Coast & Environment

A Tiny Snail Helps LSU Researchers Understand Louisiana’s Changing Coast

College of Humanities & Social Sciences

LSU’s Tim Slack to Bring Louisiana Perspective to National Rural Research Leadership Role

Winning for Louisiana

LSU Engineering and Our Lady of the Lake Health Advance AI, Digital Health, and Precision Medicine A…

School of Information Studies

LSU FLOOD Project Connects 1927 Great Mississippi Flood to Education and Resilience

CCT

Four LSU Faculty Earn Highly Prestigious NSF CAREER Awards

CCT

“It’s really a pretty beautiful relationship”

CCT

LSU and University of Rhode Island Win $4M NSF Award to Advance Wetland Science Across Two Coasts

Get Involved

Your time at LSU will go by fast. Whether it’s exploring your interests, helping out in the community, or getting a head start on your career, there are plenty of ways you can get involved. 

 

 

A Supportive Community

LSU is committed to responding to reports of sexual misconduct and to providing survivors with access to medical and emotional support.

Power-Based Violence and Title IX

Stay Safe LSU is a university initiative dedicated to the safety and security of our students, faculty, and staff. 

Stay Safe

Whether it’s transitioning to the college environment, participating in peer-mentoring programs or staying on track with your degree, we provide the resources you need to become part of the LSU community and to thrive within it.

Student Life
